Crochet Carrie Creations commission info
I crochet fantasy creatures such as Pokémon! (but I'm happy to try any other kind of creature you might like, too)
Price depends on complexity of design. Some examples:
EASY £50 - £80. simple shape + few details. Example Pokémon are Drifloon, Wooper and Shuppet.
MEDIUM £100 - £180. simple shape + more details or more complex shape + few details. Example Pokémon are Quilava, Wattrel and Combee.
HARD £200 - £300. more complex shape + many details. the majority of Pokémon are this level! Example Pokémon are Snivy, Houndoom and Scyther.
VERY HARD £400+. very complex shape + many complex details + aaaa. i'm up for the challenge! but it'll take a while. Example Pokémon is Koraidon.
finished sizes vary, but usually no bigger than 10-15cm (4-6in)
all prices in GBP, payment via Paypal
ships from UK, shipping cost added onto base price
will not do: humans, species that are basically human in appearance; clothes (but accessories like scarves etc are okay); nsfw/gore; horror monsters.
cannot do: translucent/transparent parts (sorry Solosis and friends!)
